intuition.title: Three related cores share a two-stage shelling route
intuition.text: CIS, CIGS and ZCIS differ in explicitly stated core-cation feed. OTT supplies sulfur and passivates the surface; two separately prepared zinc feeds grow ZnS shells for one hour each at240°C. Feed ratios do not measure final core stoichiometry.

intuition.title: Only one oxide composition has absolute salt charges
intuition.text: The Zn0.95Mg0.05O example uses2.85mmol Zn acetate dihydrate and0.15mmol Mg acetate tetrahydrate in30mL DMSO. The x=0 and0.1 variants adjust molar proportions with other parameters fixed. Their salt charges and the concentration/form of5mL TMAH remain unknown.

intuition.title: Size evidence remains specimen-specific
intuition.text: TEM mean3.2nm is assigned to CIGS/ZnS only. ZnO andZn0.9Mg0.1O have4.2nm and3.1nm means respectively; the x=0.05 size is not given. Similar-size wording and additional ZCIS images do not establish missing numeric means.

intuition.title: Dispersion and film energy levels are different measurements
intuition.text: Optical bandgaps of ZnMgO dispersions are3.73,3.89,4.07eV, while solid-film TableS1 gives3.66,3.82,3.93eV. UPS tabulates positive binding energies below vacuum; the QD PESA diagram uses signed negative vacuum-referenced energies. These conventions and specimen states are preserved.
intuition.source_locator: Main pp.3–4; SI TableS1 and FigureS3

intuition.title: Nine devices do not represent nine additional nanoparticle batches
intuition.text: Three QD EMLs combine with three ZnMgO ETLs. The common fabrication method and exact maxima remain source-specific. Figure4b cross-section depicts only CIS/ZnS withZn0.95Mg0.05O; no other device borrows that image as its measured specimen.

intuition.title: Efficiency interpretation is qualified
intuition.text: Raising the oxide conduction band with Mg is proposed to improve electron injection. CIS device efficiency peaks atx=0.05, while CIGS and ZCIS efficiency increases throughx=0.1. Excess electron injection is a proposed explanation for the CIS efficiency decrease, not an independently established causal measurement.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
